_schema.note: Host-owned Phase 3 config (FW-0024, ADR-0070). Delete this file to reset to built-in defaults. 'reward' + 'cue' + the sequence 'generator'/'debias_blocks' are editable from the Phase 3 tab (Save settings); the rest of 'sequence' holds scientific schedule params - hand-edit here only. seed: null = fresh random each launch, an integer pins the schedule. generator: 'balanced' (counterbalanced, default) or 'debias_blocks' (counterbalanced + closed-loop corrective blocks when a side bias develops).
